name: Solar energy collector
rulesStatus: owner-approved generation, storage, solar exhaustion fallback, and Overdrive; host exhaustion authority/persistence pending
description: A solar-driven magical generator with an integrated rechargeable battery. Sunlight generates and stores energy. If supply is insufficient, the generator continues at normal output while the Construct accrues exhaustion. Concentrated sunlight enables Overdrive.

name: Soul-powered core
rulesStatus: owner-approved narrative behavior; candidate 8/12 output and 30-foot radius; soul-energy sufficiency and consumption remain DM-adjudicated
description: An inherently active magical generator that automatically imprisons eligible souls released by deaths within its capture range. Capture is involuntary and has no fixed storage limit. Captured souls fuel power; their consumption and the nature of the core's interior are intentionally undefined.

name: Infernal Engine
rulesStatus: owner-approved 8-unit output, long-rest fuel, and once-per-turn fire-damage Infernal Empowerment; damage amount, qualifying attacks, fuel quantity and instability remain unresolved
description: An infernal generator with long-rest sustaining fuel. Missed sustenance imposes instability without shutting down normal power. Additional fuel activates Infernal Empowerment until the next long rest, granting a once-per-turn fire-damage enhancement once its damage value and trigger are separately authored.

name: Arcane-consuming core
rulesStatus: provisional output and recipe; fuel/sustaining rules not yet balanced
description: Consumes an available arcane energy resource under separately authored operating rules.

name: Mechanical engine
rulesStatus: provisional output and recipe; fuel/sustaining rules not yet balanced
description: A basic mechanical generator with eight power output. Its daily sustenance is one ordinary mechanical-fuel charge instead of a food ration. Normal deprivation and recovery use the shared 2014 food-survival rules. Overdrive and fuel inventory transactions remain separately authored.
